incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=auth-token-verify severity=critical :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Trigger: auth-token-verify (service id: svc_7a2b) — 7 incidents in last 5m — details: 401s spike validating JWTs against JWKS cache

Alexei (oncall): acked via PagerDuty — I'm on it, pulling logs and tracing token flows
Priya M: reading alert now, can you confirm which envs? hosted api or dedicated?
Alexei (oncall): primarily hosted API in us-west-2, some 401s showing for dedicated customers too but lower volume
Ryan K: saw dashboard spike on /v1/auth/verify — added link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/xyz/auth-verify?from=now-15m

Samir (SRE): pagerduty escalation to SRE team — pinging @Samir — can you check JWKS propagation and KMS signing key service?
Samir (SRE): joining. quick summary from logs:
```
[2026-03-14T12:02:11Z] verify: token_id=abc123 client=tenant-prod-15 status=401 err="kid not found in jwks"
[2026-03-14T12:02:13Z] jwks-fetch: last_update=2026-03-14T11:58:30Z src=kms-key-rotation job=oncall-rotate
```

Priya M: kid not found -> sounds like signing key rotated but not present in JWKS or cache TTL issue
Alexei (oncall): repro locally: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token-with-new-kid>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/verify -i` returns `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized`

opsbot: Automations: increase JWKS fetch frequency for auth-verify service to 30s for next 15m — applied on staging, rolling to prod in 1m — will report back
opsbot: Note: this is a temporary mitigation; still need to reconcile keyset

Samir (SRE): checking keyring service logs — looks like a canary rotation started at 11:58:25Z but the publish to the JWKS endpoint failed with 502 from edge-lb (timeout)
Ryan K: oh — so tokens were signed with the new key, but JWKS endpoint returned 502 -> clients couldn't fetch new kid -> validate failed
Priya M: what's scope of customer impact? any errors for token issuance?

Alexei (oncall): quick tally from traces: ~4.2K failed verifications in 20m window, impacting ~12 tenants (list sampled in incidents dashboard), most traffic coming from token verification for generation endpoints (hosted customers)
Samir (SRE): mitigation plan:
- Step 1: enable fallback to previous signing key for token verification in auth-verify (hotfix toggle)
- Step 2: force-refresh JWKS cache across all auth-verify pods
- Step 3: re-publish JWKS from keyring with retry and increased timeout
- Step 4: monitor error rates and begin gradual rollout of rotation again
Alexei (oncall): executing step 1 now: toggling `auth.verify.allow_fallback_signing_key = true` via runtime-config -> toggled
Alexei (oncall): verify endpoints now show drop in 401s, but still some stragglers due to long-lived pods
Priya M: Step 2 request: can someone run `kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-verify -n prod --selector=zone=us-west-2` across zones to flush cache? I can coordinate with infra if needed
Samir (SRE): doing a rolling restart with maxUnavailable=10% to avoid spike — kicking off restarts in us-west-2 then us-east-1

opsbot: Running: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-verify -n prod --selector=zone=us-west-2` (batch 1 of 4)

[12:17:42] Alexei (oncall): batch 1 done, error rate dropped from 18%->2% for that batch of pods
[12:21:11] Samir (SRE): re-published JWKS with enhanced retries and 10s timeout — publish succeeded, JWKS now shows new kid and previous kid

Priya M: confirmation: edge cache invalidation for JWKS CDN completed?
Ryan K: yes — CDN purge propagated, TTLs set to 30s for next 10m

PagerDuty: Escalation note: incident acknowledged by Alexei (oncall) at 12:05, escalated to SRE (Samir) at 12:09, remediation actions executed starting 12:12 — resolved status pending verification

Alexei (oncall): customer-facing impact summary to draft for CSMs:
- What happened: key rotation attempted; JWKS endpoint failed to publish temporarily; newly issued tokens used new kid not present in JWKS cache -> verification failed (401)
- Scope: ~12 tenants, primarily hosted API customers; ~4.2k failed verifications over 20m window; no evidence of token issuance failures (issuance succeeded but verification failed downstream)
- Mitigation: enabled fallback verification path, forced JWKS cache refresh via rolling restart, re-published JWKS with retries, CDN purge, increased JWKS fetch frequency temporarily
- Next steps: postmortem, add publish retries + circuit breaker, improve monitoring for kid-mismatch to auto-open a high-priority runbook

Priya M: I'll prep the initial customer note and coordinate with support to reach out to top 5 impacted tenants — tagging CSMs now :bell:

Samir (SRE): root-cause preliminary: race during signed-key rollout — the keyring publish job retried but upstream LB returned 502 for a short window; our verification clients are strict and don't tolerate missing kid; fallback path prevented wider outage but we need safer rollout

Ryan K: logging snippet to attach to postmortem: `error="kid not found in jwks" count=4234 window=20m env=prod`

Alexei (oncall): handoff to next oncall (Priya) at 12:30 — I'll update the incident channel and set status->monitoring
Priya M: taking over monitoring, will keep ops-schedule looped in

Samir (SRE): action items assigned:
- Samir: add exponential retry + jitter for JWKS publish (PR tracked: infra/patches#451)
- Ryan: add alarm that triggers when key-rotate jobs complete but verification errors spike (alerts infra/alerting#87)
- Alexei: write up incident notes and timeline for postmortem doc
- Priya: customer comms + CSM coordination

opsbot: Incident status -> monitoring. incidents-db updated with ticket id INC-2026-3147

[12:45] PagerDuty: Incident marked as resolved in PagerDuty by Alexei (oncall) — verification error rates returned to baseline <0.5% for 15m window

Alexei (oncall): closing thread for now, keeping postmortem in progress — will ping here when doc is up. Thanks all for quick responses :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3147 closed (duration ~43m) — postmortem required, severity=sev2
